በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ዘይረክበከ: ረክበ — what will find, befall you (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, r-k-b, + -ከ 'you')
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
ገበርከ: ገብረ — you have done (2ms perfect, g-b-r)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ትከውን: ኮነ — you will be (2ms imperfect) · also 3fs 'she/it becomes, is' (እንተ ትከውን ሲሳየ 'which is food')
ይቤሉ: ብህለ — they said (3mp perfect ይቤሉ, b-h-l)
ላህምከ: ላህም — of your oxen, cattle (noun + -ከ '2ms your'; genitive after construct)
ወመራዕየ: መርዔት — and pastures of (ወ- + plural መራዕይ of መርዔት, construct, accusative)
ለእለ: እለ — to those who (ለ- 'to' + relative pronoun pl.) · ለ- marking the object: 'those who' (ያአምር ለእለ ስሕቱ 'he discerns those who have erred')
በታሕተ: ታሕተ — under, beneath (በ- + preposition ታሕተ, construct)
እገሪከ: እግር — your feet (noun, plural እገር + -ከ '2ms your', accusative)
ወይፌኑ: ፈነወ — and he would send (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G; habitual 'would send') · 'and he will send' with God as subject, future (ወይፌኑ እግዚኣብሔር ረኃበ 'and God will send hunger'; 3ms of this third-weak verb, though it looks plural)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ሠናይት: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adjective, fem. sg. ሠናይት)
ወበምድር: ምድር — and on earth (ወ- + በ- + noun)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay')
መዋዕለ: መዋዕል — days (noun, plural of ዕለት; construct 'days of')
ወይፈትሕ: ፈትሐ — and he judges, sets free (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, f-t-ḥ)
ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ወትኴንን: ኰነነ — and you will rule, judge (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, G, k-ʷ-n-n)
ወለከሰ: ለ — and as for you (ወ- + ለ- + -ከ '2ms' + emphatic -ሰ)
ወትከውን: ኮነ — and you will be (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, k-w-n; the same letters could be 3fs 'she', see the unit note)
መልዕልተ: መልዕልት — surface, upper part; upon (noun, construct, used as preposition)
እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there) · than, in comparison (ጥበብ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ 'wisdom is better than all')
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ለመንግሥትከ: መንግሥት — for your kingdom (ለ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
ወይትሌዐል: ተለዐለ — and may he be exalted (ወ- + 3ms jussive, tä-stem, root l-ʿ-l 'be high')
ወከመ: ከመ — and that (ወ- 'and' + conjunction) · and like, and as (ወ- + ከመ 'like, as' before a noun: ወከመ ፈውስ ለድዉይ 'and like healing to the sick')
በቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, in the presence of (በ- + preposition)
ወበቅድመ: ቅድመ — and before (ወ- + በ- + preposition, with a following construct)
በኵሉ: ኵሉ — in all, by all (በ- + ኵሉ)
ወይገብር: ገብረ — and he does, makes (ወ- + 3m sg imperfect, g-b-r)
ወትወርስ: ወርሰ — and you will inherit (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, G, w-r-s)
አህጉረ: ሀገር — cities (noun; plural አህጉር, accusative form)
በብዝኀ: ብዝኀ — in the multitude of (በ- + construct 'multitude of', from ብዝኀ)
ትገብር: ገብረ — you make, build (2ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
ሎቱ: ለ — to him, for him (preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
ምድረ: ምድር — land, earth (noun, f.; construct 'land of' / accusative)
ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
ይወፅኡ: ወጽአ — they come out (3mp imperfect, G)
በኀቤሁ: ኀበ — from him, with him (በ- + ኀቤሁ 'to him'; sense 'from him' preferred, 'to him' possible) (?)
ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
ትእዛዞ: ትእዛዝ — his command (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the command of God')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
ለዘ: ዘ — (to/of the one) whom (ለ- + relative pronoun; ወቦ ለዘ 'and there is one whom') · to him who (ለእግዚኣብሔር ለዘ ገብረ ኵሎ 'to God, who made all')
ዐውደ: ዐውድ — circle, cycle, round (noun; construct 'cycle of')
ለነዳይ: ነዳይ — to the poor (ለ- + adjective used as a noun)
ማውታ: ሙት — the dead; carrion (plural ማውታ, cf. ዕጓለ ማውታ 'orphan', lit. 'child of the dead'; sense here uncertain)
እምእደ: እድ — from the hand of (እም- + noun, construct)
ገጽ: ገጽ — face (noun) · side, place (በ፩ ገጽ 'on one side, in one place')
ለገጽ: ገጽ — to the face, to appearance (ለ- + noun; ኢያደሉ ለገጽ 'show no partiality')
